column_notes.direct_cognition_rank.effect_direction: NOT_MEANINGFUL_AT_GENE_LEVEL: catalog betas refer to different variants and effect alleles across studies; a gene has no sign until a colocalised molecular effect gives it one.
column_notes.direct_cognition_rank.cross_study_hetero: NOT_COMPUTABLE: needs independent gene-level statistics; the two open meta-analyses (Davies 2018, Savage 2018) both contain UK Biobank.
column_notes.direct_cognition_rank.number_of_independ: Distinct independence units (sorted cohort list, else PubMed ID) among STRICT-tier catalog studies. An upper bound: differently labelled cohort sets can share people.
column_notes.math_gene_rank.C_model: C = FI4 Z - (0.020 + 0.099 x g Z); C never replaces A. FI4 is one timed UKB arithmetic item: objective but low-reliability and g-saturated; FI4 and the g GWAS share UKB participants, so their noise is correlated and C is conservative.
